description: This file defines a PHP class 'SugarWidgetSubPanelTopCreateCampaignLogEntryButton' that extends 'SugarWidgetSubPanelTopButton'. The class provides methods to generate a widget ID and display a button in a SugarCRM/SuiteCRM subpanel to create a campaign log entry. The display method constructs an HTML form and button with embedded JavaScript to launch a popup window for campaign log creation, including handling user access permissions and configuration settings.

classes.name: SugarWidgetSubPanelTopCreateCampaignLogEntryButton
classes.description: PHP class for generating a 'Create Campaign Log Entry' button in a subpanel of SugarCRM/SuiteCRM, with logic for rendering an HTML form and JavaScript for pop-up handling.

methods.name: getWidgetId
methods.description: Generates a unique widget ID, appending '_select_button' suffix.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Renders the HTML form and button for creating a new campaign log entry, including access control and JavaScript for popup window.

methods.name: getWidgetId
methods.description: Returns the widget ID, optionally with a suffix.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Generates HTML output for the button, including access control checks and JavaScript popup invocation.
